title: GreenHub UI economic and environmental screening defaults

basis.evidence_class_definition: Explicit screening assumption or user-supplied default; not an awarded subsidy or site-specific quote.
basis.uncertainty: No probability distributions unless a separate range is supplied; values are editable in Configure.
basis.runtime_policy: UI defaults only. The UI sends explicit overrides to post-route TEA/LCA; these values do not change process chemistry or balances.

electricityCostEurMWh.source_title: CBS end-user prices for natural gas and electricity
electricityCostEurMWh.source_location: 2026 first half; electricity, non-household 500–2,000 MWh/year; total price excluding VAT and including taxes
electricityCostEurMWh.basis: CBS reports €0.203/kWh for the matching non-household consumption band. Converted to €203/MWh by multiplying by 1,000. Total price is the sum of supply and network prices.
electricityCostEurMWh.applicability: Dutch non-household national average, not a site-specific tariff or supplier contract. The 2026 first-half value is provisional and includes taxes other than VAT; the selected consumption band is 500–2,000 MWh/year.
electricityCostEurMWh.uncertainty: CBS provisional half-year average; no statistical interval supplied. Contract structure, load profile, exemptions, and actual plant consumption band may differ.

dry_protein_product.basis: UI dry-protein screening value; only a benchmark analogue, not a grass-protein quote or sale contract.

biostimulant_product.basis: UI screening assumption; product quality, registration and buyer grade are unverified.

biomethane.basis: UI screening value; upgrading specification, contract and volume basis require verification.

phosphorus_product.basis: UI screening value for phosphorus product; purity and saleable grade unverified.

ammonium_product.basis: UI screening value for ammonium product; concentration/specification and market unverified.

potassium_concentrate.basis: UI screening value; concentration/specification and buyer grade unverified.

press_cake.basis: UI screening value for press cake; end use, moisture, contamination and gate fee status unverified.

nutrient_rich_solids.basis: UI screening value; nutrient specification and fertilizer-product status unverified.

electricityKgCo2eKwh.basis: JRC life-cycle electricity factor 0.406463 t CO2e/MWh, converted numerically to 0.406463 kg CO2e/kWh; includes upstream electricity supply-chain emissions.
electricityKgCo2eKwh.applicability: National Netherlands consumption mix; appropriate as a lifecycle grid factor, not a site-specific supplier factor. Published time series ends in 2021.
electricityKgCo2eKwh.uncertainty: Dataset point estimate; no probability distribution imposed. Do not interpret year-to-year variation as a confidence interval.

heatKgCo2eKwh.source_table_page: CE Delft publication summary, end-user total heat factor for 2022
heatKgCo2eKwh.basis: CE Delft reports 30.96 kg CO2e/GJ total end-user heat factor for Dutch heat grids in 2022 (direct emissions plus supply-chain emissions); converted using 1 GJ = 277.7778 kWh.
heatKgCo2eKwh.applicability: Dutch average heat-grid factor based on reported 2022 heat-source deployment; not a site- or supplier-specific network factor.
heatKgCo2eKwh.uncertainty: Published national average; source page does not provide a probability distribution. Do not treat this point estimate as site-specific.

grass_utilization_bonus.label: Grass utilization / logistics bonus
grass_utilization_bonus.status: User-defined scenario assumption; not an awarded subsidy.
grass_utilization_bonus.applicability: Applied post-route to annual wet grass tonnes actually processed, with no changes to process state, balances, product yields or emissions.
grass_utilization_bonus.source: User-provided range in project instructions; no public programme eligibility or award is asserted.
